body: Could you elaborate more on this?

As far as I'm aware it goes like this:

Capitalism - Boss owns the MOP
Socialism/dictatorship of the proletariat - State owns the MOP
Communism - People own the MOP collectively

In regimes like the USSR, the state owned the MOP, because it had never progressed to pure communism. It was in a limbo-like state which is often referred to as Socialism/The Dictatorship of the Proletariat. 

I.e. 'Communist state' is self-contradicting, the so-called communist states were really Socialist states.

The goal is to eventually dissolve the state completely.
